title: Capital market stocks rise on CAS fix hopes, index closes 1% higher
raw_summary: Capital market stocks saw gains Friday after regulator Sebi's circular on the Closing Auction Session mechanism. title: RBI Turns to Longer-Dated VRRR for Liquidity Mop-Up
raw_summary: In an effort to control escalating inflation, the Reserve Bank of India is running auctions to draw in surplus liquidity from the financial system. Additionally, the central bank recently sold government securities worth thirty-two thousand crore.
